answer: What survives to the beacon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Work waits on the trellis until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the wander of the next round. The design leans on time-locked work history, published publicly on failure, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
